command:
set -eu
getent passwd nobody daemon | cut -d: -f1,3,4
rm -f /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-nobody /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon /tmp/sticky-rm.err
runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'printf "%s\n" nobody-owned > /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-nobody'
runuser -u daemon -- sh -c 'printf "%s\n" daemon-owned > /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon'
printf '%s\n' '--- both distinct users can create ---'
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-nobody /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon
set +e
runuser -u daemon -- rm /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-nobody 2>/tmp/sticky-rm.err
daemon_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'daemon-removes-nobody rc=%s error=' "$daemon_rc"
tr '\n' ' ' < /tmp/sticky-rm.err
printf '\n'
if [ "$daemon_rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: cross-user removal unexpectedly succeeded'; exit 1; fi
[ -f /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-nobody ]
printf '%s\n' 'nobody-owned file remains after forbidden removal attempt'
runuser -u nobody -- rm /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-nobody
runuser -u daemon -- rm /srv/drop/.sticky-proof-daemon
printf '%s\n' '--- owners can remove their own files; probes cleaned ---'
find /srv/drop -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -name '.sticky-proof-*' -print
stat -c 'mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /srv/drop
printf 'os=%s kernel=%s\n' "$(. /etc/os-release; printf '%s' "$PRETTY_NAME")" "$(uname -r)"
